native_mechanisms: Sun-strike: one simultaneous compare of both ropes marks every same-dye crossing (match) at once, without visiting cells
Sparse treasure-to-treasure DP: cost of the empty stretch between two matches is computed in closed form from index offsets, never by filling the intervening cells
Per-match dominance pruning of running tallies in two states (slip spent / slip unspent), keeping only the cheapest and dropping the rest
core_technique: Exact Needleman-Wunsch computed as a score-bound banded anti-diagonal wavefront with 16-bit SSE2/AVX2 lanes (plus scalar two-row DP fallbacks), band width derived from the identity-diagonal match count
